style: instrumental video game defeat sting, 5 seconds. The startup just died — money gone or founder broken — and the game is about to show the autopsy page. A felt piano phrase starts confident, then deflates: two notes land comically wrong, hesitate, and a soft low upright bass thud closes the lid.
